incident-bot: PAGERS: High error rate detected on api-gateway-eu: 502/504 spike for /v1/embeddings (12% 5xx over 2m). Pager: #oncall-sre. Dashboard: https://rwd/instrumentation/graphs/2187650000 :rotating_light:
marya: ack — I'm on it (on-call). pinging infra and edge teams. pulling logs now.
alex: seeing a sudden jump in upstream connect timeouts to embed-backend-eu. conn attempts -> long tails, many keepalive resets.
sam: confirmed — ingress queue depth at the edge-router spiked at 11:07 UTC, CPU steady but socket backlog high. suspect long-lived requests from a small customer batch job.
nicole: customer impact: several production customers report failures for embeddings (batch jobs); fallback retries causing client-side duplicates. quoting a customer: "embedding requests timeout after 30s".
marya: immediate mitigation plan: 1) enable per-route circuit-breaker on /v1/embeddings (limit concurrent upstream requests) 2) shift new traffic to us-west-1 for embeddings 3) apply short-term backpressure (reject with 429) for heavy clients. executing now.
alex: applying circuit-breaker via control plane: `route.get('/v1/embeddings').circuit_breaker(max_concurrent=50, time_window=10s)` — pushing.
sam: starting traffic-shift job: weights {eu:20, us:80} for embedding-route. will watch for error rate delta.
incident-bot: Deploy event: routing weights update started by sam. link: https://rwd/deploy/2187650000
nicole: posting customer comms draft to #support for impacted accounts. will include ETA and mitigation notes.
10m later —
alex: circuit-breaker in effect, upstream connection failures are reduced, edge backlog dropping. 5xx down to ~3.5% and trending.
sam: traffic shift to us completed to 85% due to compatibility; rolling back eu weight slowly.
marya: marking Pager as MONITORED. On-call will continue to observe for 30m, then close if stable.
nicole: support note sent to affected customers. asked them to retry with exponential backoff.
20m later —
alex: root cause hypothesis: a misbehaving client started large parallel long-running batch embedding requests that saturated the edge router's connection queue and exhausted upstream sockets. not a kernel-level connpool leak.
marya: next actions: 1) add per-tenant rate-limits on embeddings 2) increase upstream connection pool transiently in eu for embed-backend (scale-1->scale-2) 3) create an alert to detect long-tail upstream connect time (P95 connect > 200ms).
sam: scaled embed-backend-eu by +1 instance; observed recovery signals.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied (circuit-breaker, traffic-shift, scale-up, support comms). Customer impact reduced.
marya: closing notes: mitigations successful, no data loss observed. Postmortem to be scheduled; assigned to alex + sam. Action items captured in backlog: RWD-INC-3421 (tenant rate-limits), RWD-INC-3422 (backpressure docs), RWD-INC-3423 (connect-time alert).
nicole: thanks team. I'll follow up with a short status to customers in 1h. :white_check_mark:
